name: The Break Sports Grill (Daybreak / South Jordan, UT) Charbroiled Plain Cheeseburger
brandOrRestaurant: The Break Sports Grill (Daybreak / South Jordan, UT)
whyItWorks: Charbroiled Angus beef patty with melted American cheese on a soft brioche bun. When ordered without raw onions, pickles, or spicy pub sauces, it is very easy on digestion.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Classic Cheeseburger plain with ketchup only (hold lettuce, tomato, onion, and pickles).
watchOuts: Hold raw onions and spicy pub sauces
